settings.title: Solution and Integration
settings.subheading: Alcohol testing solutions with seamless integration for safer, compliant workplaces

settings.text:
At Andatech, we offer cutting-edge solutions designed to enhance workplace safety, ensure compliance, and improve operational efficiency. Our advanced drug and alcohol testing technologies are trusted by businesses across various industries to minimise risks and create safer environments for employees and stakeholders.

Whether you’re managing a high-risk worksite or a corporate office, our comprehensive solutions provide the tools and support to protect your workforce and meet industry regulations.

settings.title: Reliable Testing Technology
settings.text: We leverage state-of-the-art drug and alcohol testing technologies to provide results you can depend on. Our solutions are designed with accuracy, efficiency, and ease of use in mind, ensuring seamless implementation in your workplace. Key product features include:
settings.feature_list_content:
Certified Accuracy

Australian Standards Certified devices deliver precise results for peace of mind.

Integrated Reporting

Link results from multiple sites using Andalink, our cloud platform for live reporting and centralised data management.

Ease of Use

User-friendly interfaces and quick testing processes for efficient operation in any environment.

On-Site Testing Services

Benefit from professional on-site testing facilitated by trained collectors with a stringent chain of custody procedure

Customisable Solutions

Choose from a range of testing options tailored to your specific workplace requirements.

settings.title: Andalink Cloud Integration for Seamless Management
settings.text:
The Andalink platform revolutionises the way businesses manage alcohol testing data. With real-time data reporting, businesses gain instant access to actionable insights across multiple sites. Features of Andalink include:

  • Centralised data management for streamlined operations
  • Live reporting and immediate access to testing results globally
  • Real-time alerts for exception reporting or policy breaches
  • Customisable dashboards to track trends and improve decision-making

settings.title: Aussie Time Sheets Integration
settings.text:
Our integration with Aussie Time Sheets combines precise time tracking with industry-leading drug and alcohol testing, creating a seamless system for managing employee data and ensuring compliance with workplace safety protocols.

  • Automated time tracking and testing
  • Real-time data synchronisation and reporting
  • Centralised data management with Andalink
  • Compliance with workplace safety protocols
  • Customisable configuration for schedules or policies
